name: cicada-sentinel-workspace
description: CICADA Sentinel - Privacy-First Zero-Trust AIOps Platform

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix saas-backend install && npm --prefix saas-frontend install
scripts.test:collector: python -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'local-collector'); import unittest; suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover('local-collector/tests'); result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite); sys.exit(0 if result.wasSuccessful() else 1)"
